name: Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set of Singletons
proof: Let $i$ be the first coordinate shifted downward. Its singleton moves to the empty set, while every other singleton remains. The resulting class is $\{\emptyset\}\cup\{\{j\}:j\ne i\}$, a downset, so all later shifts leave it unchanged. For $n=1$ it has VC dimension zero. For $n\ge2$ it shatters a coordinate but no pair, giving value one for every coordinate order and hence for their minimum.
